svg.title: Libris Library Borrowing System — high-fidelity wireframe board

g.text: Request a title, get it approved at the desk, and keep every due
date in sight. One calm place for borrowing, returns, and fines.
Built around the desk, not around the paperwork.
Students ask for a copy online. The shelf stays accurate
One click issues the loan, starts the 14-day clock and
Overdue charges calculate themselves. Pay, waive or
issue a manual fine in one place.
One account for browsing, requests, loans and fines.
Your role decides what you see after you sign in.
Fourteen-day loans with clear due dates
Requests reviewed by a real librarian
Fines tracked to the last peso
Sign in to continue to your library dashboard.
Demo only — accounts and passwords live in your browser.
Students only. Use a Gmail address so we can send the confirmation link.
Only @gmail.com addresses are accepted in this demo.
At least 8 characters with one uppercase letter and one number.
I agree to the library rules: 14-day loans, a 5-book limit, and ₱5/day overdue fines.
A confirmation email will appear in the Demo Mailbox, not a real inbox.
Register with your Gmail address and student
Open the simulated link in the Demo Mailbox.
The desk approves it, and the 14-day clock starts.

We sent a confirmation link to the Gmail address below. Open
it to activate your reader account.
Welcome to Libris, Juan. Confirm your email address to activate
your reader account and start requesting books.
This is a simulated email. No real message is sent.
Confirmation links expire after 24 hours. The mailbox is available on every public page.
Enter the email on your account. We will send a reset link
For security, reset links expire after 60 minutes.
We received a request to reset the password for your reader
account. Use the button below to choose a new one.
If you did not request this, you can ignore the email. Your password will not change.
Demo mode: this link is simulated and appears
Reset link verified — valid for another 58 minutes.
This demo stores passwords locally only.
After saving, all active sessions would be signed out in a real system.
Here is what is due, what is waiting for approval, and what to read next.
2 borrow requests are waiting for desk approval
The copies stay available until a librarian approves them.
Return at the desk when you are finished.
Requests take a moment to review.
Search 24 physical copies across nine subject areas. Each row is one copy.
Search by title, author or ISBN…
Requests are reviewed by a librarian. Once approved, the copy is marked Borrowed and the 14-day due date begins.
A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones. Small
changes, repeated consistently, compound into remarkable results.
You are eligible to request this copy
No unpaid fines. You have 2 of 5 active loans and 1 pending request.
The 14-day loan starts when a librarian approves your request.
This catalog entry represents one physical copy. Returning it at the desk immediately makes it available to
the next student. Lost or damaged copies are recorded by staff and may carry a fine.
Track requests waiting for approval, current due dates, and every loan you have returned.
These copies stay available until a librarian approves them.
Settle overdue charges to keep requesting books. Fines are finalised when a loan is returned.
Pay or have the charge waived at the desk before requesting another book.
Payments are simulated in this demo. In production, the desk records cash or online payments.
Keep your contact details current and manage how you sign in.

Shown to library staff when you borrow or return a copy.
Gmail address used for verification and notifications.

Items past their due date, oldest first.
The Great Gatsby · Clean Code · Sapiens
Send a courtesy reminder from the student record.
2 requests are waiting for a decision.
Check loans, fines and contact details.
Review what students have asked to borrow. A copy is only marked Borrowed after approval.
The 14-day loan starts at approval. If two students request the same copy, approving one declines the other automatically.
A request does not reserve the copy.
The student picks an available copy
Approve to issue, or decline to keep it
The loan clock and due date begin
Each row is one physical copy. Copies on loan cannot be deleted or marked unavailable until returned.
Search by title, author or book ID…
On-loan copies are locked until the return is processed.
Approve student requests, issue a loan at the desk, or close one when the copy comes back.
Fines are finalised only when you process the return.
Look up a borrower, review their history, or check why a request is blocked.
A student at 5 loans cannot request another copy.
Collect or waive charges, or record a manual fine for a damaged or lost copy.
Unpaid fines block new requests until paid or waived.
The desk is covered. One librarian account still needs to finish setup.

You have full oversight of loans, books and students.
Changes are attributed to your account.
Create, edit and remove librarian accounts. Superlibrarian accounts are managed separately.
New librarians receive a temporary password
They must choose a new password at first sign-in. Deleting an account keeps its past checkout records as “Former
